verdict.rationale: The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec: every candidate path, including /openapi.json, /swagger.json and /.well-known/openapi.json, returned 404. The evidence shows an llms.txt file and markdown versions of the API reference pages, but these are LLM-friendly prose docs, not a downloadable machine-readable API specification. They are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
